summary: Returns column list + types (+ BQ stats) for a table. BQ requires dataset_id+table_id; RS/SF require table_id and use dataset_id-or-default_schema as the schema.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Which engine.

params.name: table_id
params.doc: Table name. Required for all engines.

params.name: dataset_id
params.doc: BigQuery: REQUIRED (with table_id). RS/SF: optional schema, defaults to connection default_schema.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: BQ auto-selects when single.

params.name: dataset_id
params.doc: RS/SF schema name; defaults to creds['default_schema'].

returns: { schema: [ {name/column_name, type, ...} ], num_rows?, num_bytes?, modified_time? } | {error, message}

summary: ROUTED BUT UNCALLABLE via warehouse_read: WAREHOUSE_READ_ROUTES maps get_warehouse_usage -> ('warehouse_read','get_warehouse_usage'), but legacy warehouse_read has NO such handler (it lives in warehouse_audit, Snowflake-only). Rejected by _VALID_ACTIONS for every engine.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Engine (irrelevant — fails action-validation).

returns: {error:true, message:"Unknown action 'get_warehouse_usage' for <engine> warehouse_read. Valid actions: ..."}

summary: Lists the user's connected warehouses of the given engine (one of three branch shapes; no connection required).

params.name: engine
params.doc: Which warehouse engine. Selects the per-engine branch.

returns: { connections: [ { connection_id, display_name, connection_status, created_at, ...engine-specific: BQ(project_id,datasets[]) | RS(database,default_schema) | SF(warehouse,database,default_schema) } ] }

summary: Lists Snowflake databases. Snowflake-only (Redshift's _VALID_ACTIONS has no list_databases).

params.name: engine
params.doc: Must be 'snowflake'. Not valid for bigquery or redshift.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: Resolved via _get_snowflake_conn; NOT auto-selected when single (only BQ has the single-connection auto-select).

summary: Lists BigQuery datasets for the resolved connection (cached META_TTL). BigQuery-only.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Must be 'bigquery'; rejected with 'Unknown action' for redshift/snowflake.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: Auto-selected when the user has exactly one BQ connection (see _get_bq_conn smart default).

summary: Lists schemas. Redshift uses creds only; Snowflake requires creds['database']. Not valid for BigQuery.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Must be 'redshift' or 'snowflake'.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: Resolved per engine; no single-connection auto-select for RS/SF.

summary: Lists tables in a dataset/schema. BQ requires dataset_id; RS/SF fall back to the connection's default_schema when dataset_id omitted.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Which engine.

params.name: dataset_id
params.doc: BigQuery: REQUIRED. Redshift/Snowflake: optional — names the schema; falls back to connection default_schema.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: BQ auto-selects when single; RS/SF resolved by id.

params.name: dataset_id
params.doc: For RS/SF this is really the SCHEMA name (named dataset_id). Defaults to creds['default_schema'].

params.name: engine
params.doc: Must be 'snowflake'.

params.name: connection_id
params.doc: Resolved via _get_snowflake_conn.

summary: ROUTED BUT UNCALLABLE via warehouse_read: the public WAREHOUSE_READ_ROUTES maps preview_table -> ('warehouse_read','preview_table'), but legacy warehouse_read has NO preview_table handler — it is rejected by _VALID_ACTIONS for every engine. (The real preview_table lives in warehouse_query.)

params.name: engine
params.doc: Engine (irrelevant — action fails action-validation regardless).

params.name: dataset_id
params.doc: Documented for preview_table but never reached.

params.name: table_id
params.doc: Documented for preview_table but never reached.

returns: {error:true, message:"Unknown action 'preview_table' for <engine> warehouse_read. Valid actions: ..."}
